title: Refining of Metals
notes: **Purpose:** to obtain metal of high purity by removing impurities from the crude metal obtained by reduction.
**Poling:** used for copper refining. Molten copper is stirred with green poles of wood, which reduce any oxide impurities. The hydrocarbon gases released also help remove dissolved gases.
**Electro-refining:** impure metal is made the anode and pure metal the cathode in a solution of its salt. Pure metal deposits on the cathode; impurities fall as anode mud.
**Copper electro-refining:** anode: impure Cu; cathode: pure Cu sheet; electrolyte: $CuSO_4$ + $H_2SO_4$. Impurities like Fe, Zn dissolve; Au, Ag, Pt fall as anode mud.
**Aluminium refining:** Hoopes process uses three layers: molten impure Al anode, molten cryolite electrolyte, molten pure Al cathode.
